@@ wood_elves
Wood Elves are more numerous and “rustic” than their breth ren, the High Elves and the Grey Elves. They live in the safety o the woods, forests, and mountains.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: Most are slight of build, and all are thin by mannis standards. Males average 150 lbs; females, 125 lbs. Coloring: Ruddy of complexion, with sandy hair and blue o green eyes. Generalizations are difficult, however, since the are many kindreds. Endurance: They are capable of traveling 16-20 hours a day. Se the general Elf description in Section A-3.0. Height: Males average 6'0"; females, 5'9". Lifespan: They are immortal and will only die due to violence o if they weary of life and lose the will to live. Resistance: They cannot become sick or scarred and are virtuall immune to disease. +10 DB and RR bonuses versus col attacks. Special Abilities: See the general Elf description in Section A 3.0. The Wood Elf folk are superb musicians and have tremen dous hearing, even for Elves (they get a special +10 bonus t Base Spell attacks from Bard spell lists). They get a special +1 bonus to their Trickery skill and their Stalking, and Hidin skill.

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: Their preferred clothes are usuall forest green, grey, or brown, and range from functional design to fanciful expressions of individual creativity. Fears & Inabilities: Nothing special. Lifestyle: The culture of the Wood Elves is best characterized a unstructured and rustic by Elven standards, but rich and rela tively advanced when compared to the ways of Men. They ar independent, but many have settled in kingdoms ruled by th High Elves or Grey Elves. Still, all the Wood Elf folk enjoy good journey or adventure and most look at life much as a gam to be played. Music and trickery are their favorite pastimes. Th Wood Elves are also masters of the wood and know much o wood-craft and wood-lore. Marriage Pattern: Monogamous and for life. Religion: Informal and centered around communal celebratio and personal meditation.

@@ ther_actors
Demeanor: They are a fun-loving but guarded folk. Outwar mirth often hides their grim intentions. Language: Starting Languages: Elvish (S10/W10), Grey-elvis (S8/W6), Common-speech (S8/W6), High-elvish (S4/W4 Allowed Adolescence Development: Grey-elvish (S10/W10 Common-speech (S10/W10), High-elvish (S10/W10), High speech (S4/W4), Plains-speech (S8/W8), Wood-speech (S8 W8). Prejudices: The Wood Elves readily seclude themselves, fo they have a less friendly history of relations with Men. The despise Orcs, dislike Dwarves, and are suspicious of Men. Professions: No special notes. Special Skills: Everyman: Music, Play Instrument, Tricker Wood-crafting; Restricted: none.
